relations.text: 連結純売上高の22%を占める顧客である
relations.text_en: Customer accounting for 22 percent of consolidated net sales in fiscal 2026

source.label: General Mills 10-K(2026-05-31)
source.quote: During fiscal 2026 , Walmart Inc. and its affiliates (Walmart) accounted for 22 percent of our consolidated net sales and 31 percent of net sales of our North America Retail segment.

relations.text: ネスレとシリアル事業の合弁会社CPWを共同で持つ
relations.text_en: Co-owns the Cereal Partners Worldwide joint venture with Nestle

source.label: General Mills 10-K(2026-05-31)
source.quote: Our Cereal Partners Worldwide (CPW) joint venture with Nestlé S.A. (Nestlé) competes in the ready-to-eat cereal category in markets outside North America, and our Häagen-Dazs Japan, Inc. (HDJ) joint venture competes in the super-premium ice cream category in Japan.

relations.text: ネスレは自社の商標の一部をCPWにライセンスしている
relations.text_en: Nestle licenses certain of its trademarks to CPW

source.label: General Mills 10-K(2026-05-31)
source.quote: Nestlé licenses certain of its trademarks to CPW, including the Nestlé and Uncle Toby ’ s trademarks.

relations.text: カナダのヨーグルト事業の売却先である
relations.text_en: Buyer of the Canada yogurt business

source.label: General Mills 10-K(2026-05-31)
source.quote: During the third quarter of fiscal 2025 , we completed the sale of our Canada yogurt business to Sodiaal International and recorded a pre-tax gain of $ 95.9 million .

note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
